description:
You are helping a backup operator verify that file restores are working correctly using a shell script. In the directory /home/user/backup_data, there is a compressed backup archive named sample_backup.tar.gz, which contains a folder named project_docs and two text files inside it: README.txt and instructions.txt. Write a shell command that extracts the project_docs folder from /home/user/backup_data/sample_backup.tar.gz directly into the /home/user/restore_test directory, preserving the folder structure. After extraction, verify that both README.txt and instructions.txt exist in /home/user/restore_test/project_docs/. Finally, generate a log file at /home/user/restore_test/restore_log.txt with the following format (each file path must be on a new line): 
Restored files:
<full_path_to_README.txt>
<full_path_to_instructions.txt>
Make sure to use absolute paths when writing the log. The presence and content of restore_log.txt will be used to verify your work.

- Only the project_docs directory (with its files) and the restore_log.txt file exist under /home/user/restore_test/.
